description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for calims to property of intestate in Kumbaloluwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510260 and to 03 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on land title registration and property claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
